cases.sql:
SELECT sp.specNumber AS specNumber, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.node_id) AS crCount
                     FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id
                     JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=rr.dst_id
                     JOIN rel_MODIFIES cm ON cm.src_id=cr.node_id
                     JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=cm.dst_id
                     GROUP BY sp.specNumber ORDER BY crCount DESC, specNumber ASC

SELECT DISTINCT s.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,s.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=ir.src_id JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=rk.node_id JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=bs.src_id WHERE hub.specNumber=? AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND s.level=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CR cr JOIN rel_MODIFIES e ON e.src_id=cr.node_id WHERE e.dst_id=hub.node_id)

SELECT m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber,
                            m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal,
                            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1 FROM rel_MODERATED_BY mb
                              JOIN Company co ON co.node_id=mb.dst_id
                              WHERE mb.src_id=unit.node_id AND co.companyName='ZTE'
                            ) THEN unit.node_id END) AS moderatorSummaryCount
                     FROM Meeting m LEFT JOIN rel_MADE_AT ma ON ma.dst_id=m.node_id
                     LEFT JOIN Summary unit ON unit.node_id=ma.src_id
                     GROUP BY m.node_id ORDER BY meetingOrdinal ASC
SELECT tdocNumber AS "t.tdocNumber", title AS "t.title", "status" AS "t.status" FROM Tdoc WHERE tdocNumber=?
SELECT tdocNumber AS "t.tdocNumber", title AS "t.title", "for" AS "t.for" FROM Tdoc WHERE tdocNumber=?

SELECT DISTINCT t.tdocNumber FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sub ON sub.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Company co ON co.node_id=sub.dst_id JOIN rel_RELATED_TO rel ON rel.src_id=t.node_id JOIN WorkItem wi ON wi.node_id=rel.dst_id JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT at ON at.src_id=t.node_id JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=at.dst_id WHERE co.companyName=? AND wi.workItemCode=?

WITH effects AS (SELECT src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC UNION ALL SELECT src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC UNION ALL SELECT src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_OM_SPEC) SELECT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,COUNT(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS impactCount FROM CR cr LEFT JOIN effects e ON e.src_id=cr.node_id LEFT JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=e.dst_id GROUP BY cr.node_id ORDER BY impactCount DESC,tdocNumber ASC

SELECT DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber FROM CR cr
 JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=m.dst_id
 JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Release target ON target.node_id=tr.dst_id
 WHERE hub.specNumber='38.423' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL
 AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected)<>''
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=ir.src_id
 JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=rk.node_id JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=bs.src_id
 WHERE ir.dst_id=hub.node_id AND rk.specRelease=target.releaseName
 AND declaration_token_member(cr.clausesAffected,s.sectionNumber)=1)
 ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber

cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section s
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.src_id=s.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=bs.dst_id
WHERE instr(lower(s.sectionTitle),'measurement')>0 OR instr(lower(s.sectionTitle),'reporting')>0
ORDER BY s.sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber FROM CR cr
 JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=m.dst_id
 JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Release target ON target.node_id=tr.dst_id
 WHERE hub.specNumber='38.331' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL
 AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected)<>''
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
 JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section sec ON sec.node_id=bs.src_id
 WHERE ir.dst_id=hub.node_id AND edition.specRelease=target.releaseName
 AND instr(cr.clausesAffected,sec.sectionNumber)>0
 AND original_declaration_identifier(cr.clausesAffected,sec.sectionNumber)=1)
 ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber

cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.sectionId AS sectionId,o.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,o.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_HAS_SUB_SECTION e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN Section o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.413' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='9.3.1'
ORDER BY sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT o.figureId AS figureId,o.figureNumber AS figureNumber,o.figureCaption AS figureCaption FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_CONTAINS_FIGURE e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN TSFigure o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.413' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='8.7.5.2'
ORDER BY figureId

SELECT DISTINCT o.sectionId AS sectionId,o.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,o.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_HAS_SUB_SECTION e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN Section o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.133' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='10.1'
ORDER BY sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT o.sectionId AS sectionId,o.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,o.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_HAS_SUB_SECTION e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN Section o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.101-1' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='6'
ORDER BY sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT o.tableId AS tableId,o.tableNumber AS tableNumber,o.tableCaption AS tableCaption FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_CONTAINS_TABLE e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN TSTable o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.133' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='9.2.5.1'
ORDER BY tableId

SELECT DISTINCT o.figureId AS figureId,o.figureNumber AS figureNumber,o.figureCaption AS figureCaption FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_CONTAINS_FIGURE e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN TSFigure o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.141-2' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='J.3'
ORDER BY figureId

SELECT DISTINCT o.sectionId AS sectionId,o.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,o.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_REFERENCES_SECTION e ON e.src_id=a.node_id JOIN Section o ON o.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.101-1' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='3.2'
ORDER BY sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT o.sectionId AS sectionId,o.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,o.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle FROM Spec hub
JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id JOIN Section a ON a.node_id=bs.src_id
JOIN rel_REFERENCES_SECTION e ON e.dst_id=a.node_id JOIN Section o ON o.node_id=e.src_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.133' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND a.sectionNumber='4.2'
ORDER BY sectionId

SELECT DISTINCT p.specNumber AS specNumber
FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id
JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id
WHERE instr(lower(s.sectionTitle),'antenna')>0

WITH family_domain AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.specNumber FROM Section s
 JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id
), eligible AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.specNumber,s.sectionId FROM Section s
 JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id
 WHERE instr(lower(s.sectionTitle),'harq')>0
)
SELECT d.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT e.sectionId) AS sectionCount
FROM family_domain d LEFT JOIN eligible e ON e.specNumber=d.specNumber
GROUP BY d.specNumber ORDER BY d.specNumber

WITH domain AS (SELECT DISTINCT specNumber FROM Spec WHERE specNumber IS NOT NULL),
section_counts AS (SELECT p.specNumber,count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) AS n FROM Section s
 JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id GROUP BY p.specNumber)
SELECT d.specNumber AS specNumber,coalesce(c.n,0) AS sectionCount
FROM domain d LEFT JOIN section_counts c ON c.specNumber=d.specNumber
ORDER BY sectionCount DESC,specNumber ASC

WITH family AS (SELECT DISTINCT specNumber FROM Spec WHERE specNumber LIKE '38.5%'),
counts AS (SELECT p.specNumber,count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) AS n
 FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id GROUP BY p.specNumber)
SELECT f.specNumber AS specNumber,coalesce(c.n,0) AS sectionCount
FROM family f LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.specNumber=f.specNumber
ORDER BY sectionCount DESC,specNumber ASC

SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.tdocNumber) FROM CR c JOIN rel_MODIFIES e ON e.src_id=c.node_id
  JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE p.specNumber='38.521-1' AND p.specRelease IS NULL) AS crCount,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id
  JOIN Spec p ON p.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE p.specNumber='38.521-1') AS sectionCount

SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.tdocNumber) FROM CR c JOIN rel_MODIFIES e ON e.src_id=c.node_id
  JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE hub.specNumber='38.133' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL) AS crCount,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.src_id=s.node_id
  JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE edition.specNumber='38.133') AS sectionCount

WITH anchors AS (SELECT a.node_id FROM Section a JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=a.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.214' AND a.sectionNumber='5.1') SELECT DISTINCT target.sectionId AS sectionId FROM anchors a JOIN edge ref ON ref.src_id=a.node_id AND ref.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section target ON target.node_id=ref.dst_id

WITH anchors AS (SELECT a.node_id FROM Section a JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=a.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.211' AND a.sectionNumber='5.2.1') SELECT DISTINCT source.sectionId AS sectionId FROM anchors a JOIN edge ref ON ref.dst_id=a.node_id AND ref.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section source ON source.node_id=ref.src_id

WITH anchors AS (SELECT a.node_id FROM Section a JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=a.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.214' AND a.sectionNumber='5.1') SELECT DISTINCT endpoint.sectionId AS sectionId FROM anchors a JOIN edge first ON first.src_id=a.node_id AND first.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section intermediate ON intermediate.node_id=first.dst_id JOIN edge second ON second.src_id=intermediate.node_id AND second.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section endpoint ON endpoint.node_id=second.dst_id WHERE first.edge_id<>second.edge_id

SELECT DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,t.title AS sourceTitle,t.type AS sourceType FROM Tdoc t JOIN edge p ON p.src_id=t.node_id AND p.rel_type='PRESENTED_AT' JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=p.dst_id WHERE m.canonicalMeetingNumber='RAN2#131' AND t.status='postponed' ORDER BY tdocNumber

SELECT DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
FROM CR c JOIN edge modifies ON modifies.src_id=c.node_id AND modifies.rel_type='MODIFIES'
JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=modifies.dst_id
WHERE hub.specNumber='38.133' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL
AND c.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(c.clausesAffected)<>''
AND (regexp('(?s)(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])4[.]2(?:[.][A-Za-z0-9]+)*(?![A-Za-z0-9]|[.][A-Za-z0-9])',trim(c.clausesAffected))
 OR chapter_range_contains(trim(c.clausesAffected),4))
ORDER BY tdocNumber

SELECT DISTINCT target.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section anchor JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=anchor.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge ref ON ref.src_id=anchor.node_id AND ref.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section target ON target.node_id=ref.dst_id WHERE s.specNumber='38.321' AND anchor.sectionNumber='5.4.4'

SELECT DISTINCT source.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section anchor JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=anchor.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge ref ON ref.dst_id=anchor.node_id AND ref.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section source ON source.node_id=ref.src_id WHERE s.specNumber='38.321' AND anchor.sectionNumber='5.4.3.1'

SELECT DISTINCT child.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section parent JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=parent.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id JOIN edge direct ON direct.src_id=parent.node_id AND direct.rel_type='HAS_SUB_SECTION' JOIN Section child ON child.node_id=direct.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.214' AND parent.sectionNumber='5.1'

SELECT DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber FROM CR c JOIN edge modifies ON modifies.src_id=c.node_id AND modifies.rel_type='MODIFIES' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=modifies.dst_id WHERE hub.specNumber='38.214' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND c.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND regexp('(?s)(?<![0-9A-Za-z.])5[.]1(?![0-9A-Za-z]|[.][0-9A-Za-z])',c.clausesAffected)

SELECT DISTINCT item.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section item JOIN edge inverse_ownership ON inverse_ownership.src_id=item.node_id AND inverse_ownership.rel_type='PARENT_SECTION' JOIN Section anchor ON anchor.node_id=inverse_ownership.dst_id JOIN edge specification ON specification.src_id=anchor.node_id AND specification.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=specification.dst_id WHERE edition.specNumber='38.321' AND anchor.sectionNumber='5'

SELECT DISTINCT item.tableId AS tableId FROM TSTable item JOIN edge inverse_ownership ON inverse_ownership.src_id=item.node_id AND inverse_ownership.rel_type='TABLE_IN_SECTION' JOIN Section anchor ON anchor.node_id=inverse_ownership.dst_id JOIN edge specification ON specification.src_id=anchor.node_id AND specification.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=specification.dst_id WHERE edition.specNumber='38.321' AND anchor.sectionNumber='6.2.1'

SELECT DISTINCT item.figureId AS figureId FROM TSFigure item JOIN edge inverse_ownership ON inverse_ownership.src_id=item.node_id AND inverse_ownership.rel_type='FIGURE_IN_SECTION' JOIN Section anchor ON anchor.node_id=inverse_ownership.dst_id JOIN edge specification ON specification.src_id=anchor.node_id AND specification.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=specification.dst_id WHERE edition.specNumber='38.321' AND anchor.sectionNumber='6.1.3.1'

SELECT DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber FROM Spec hub JOIN edge modification ON modification.dst_id=hub.node_id AND modification.rel_type='MODIFIES' JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=modification.src_id WHERE hub.specNumber='38.214' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND declared_ordinal_count(cr.clausesAffected)>=5

SELECT DISTINCT res.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, sec.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section sec JOIN edge ownership ON ownership.src_id=sec.node_id AND ownership.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ownership.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id JOIN edge modification ON modification.dst_id=hub.node_id AND modification.rel_type='MODIFIES' JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=modification.src_id JOIN edge mention ON mention.dst_id=cr.node_id AND mention.rel_type='REFERENCES' JOIN Resolution res ON res.node_id=mention.src_id JOIN edge release_scope ON release_scope.src_id=cr.node_id AND release_scope.rel_type='TARGET_RELEASE' JOIN Release target ON target.node_id=release_scope.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND edition.specRelease=target.releaseName AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected)<>'' AND declared_section_matches(cr.clausesAffected,sec.sectionNumber)=1

SELECT DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section s JOIN edge retained ON retained.dst_id=s.node_id AND retained.rel_type='HAS_SECTION' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=retained.src_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE s.level=1 AND hub.specNumber='38.331' AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edge modification JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=modification.src_id WHERE modification.dst_id=hub.node_id AND modification.rel_type='MODIFIES')

WITH selected AS (
 SELECT s.node_id, s.sectionId FROM Section s
 WHERE (lower(s.sectionTitle) LIKE '%pdcch%') AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM Spec sp JOIN edge b ON b.dst_id=sp.node_id
  WHERE b.src_id=s.node_id AND b.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC'))
SELECT sectionId, (SELECT json_group_array(tableId) FROM (
 SELECT DISTINCT t.tableId FROM TSTable t
 WHERE t.tableId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM edge r JOIN selected own ON own.node_id=r.src_id
  WHERE r.dst_id=t.node_id AND r.rel_type='CONTAINS_TABLE'
    AND own.sectionId=domain.sectionId)
 ORDER BY t.tableId)) AS tableIds
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sectionId FROM selected) domain ORDER BY sectionId

WITH selected AS (
 SELECT s.node_id, s.sectionId FROM Section s
 WHERE (lower(s.sectionTitle) LIKE '%srs%' OR lower(s.sectionTitle) LIKE '%sounding%') AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM Spec sp JOIN edge b ON b.dst_id=sp.node_id
  WHERE b.src_id=s.node_id AND b.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC'))

cases.sql:
WITH domain AS (SELECT DISTINCT specNumber FROM Spec WHERE specNumber IN ('38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'))
SELECT domain.specNumber,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.node_id) FROM CR c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edge e JOIN Spec target ON target.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.src_id=c.node_id AND e.rel_type='MODIFIES' AND target.specNumber=domain.specNumber)) AS crCount,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT s.sectionId) FROM Section s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edge e JOIN Spec owner ON owner.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.src_id=s.node_id AND e.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' AND owner.specNumber=domain.specNumber)) AS sectionCount
FROM domain ORDER BY crCount DESC, domain.specNumber ASC
